{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_03","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_03 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-03","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. Select * not allowed.

Filters are required: WHERE, HAVING, IN, NOT IN, EXISTS, NOT EXISTS,
ANY, SOME, ALL, LIKE, NOT LIKE, BETWEEN, NOT BETWEEN, IS NULL,
IS NOT NULL, CASE, FILTER.","name":"sql_query","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"query":{"description":"SQL query to execute (must include filters)","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name","query"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Submit a final answer for the question.","name":"submit_answer","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"description":"The final answer to submit","type":"string"}},"required":["answer"],"type":"object"}}]}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00') AND date(business_date)<=date('2026-10-23')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), totals AS (SELECT invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='payment' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS payments,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='credit' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS credits,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='hold' AND status='active' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS holds FROM active WHERE kind IN ('payment','credit','hold') GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.amount_minor,COALESCE(a.payments,0) AS payments,COALESCE(a.credits,0) AS credits,COALESCE(a.holds,0) AS holds,i.discount_until,t.business_date AS terms_date,t.discount_bps,f.business_date AS fx_date,f.fx_num,f.fx_den FROM active i LEFT JOIN totals a ON a.invoice_id=i.event_key LEFT JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date=(SELECT MAX(t2.business_date) FROM active t2 WHERE t2.kind='terms' AND t2.terms_code=i.terms_code AND date(t2.business_date)<=date(i.business_date)) LEFT JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date=(SELECT MAX(f2.business_date) FROM active f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.currency=i.currency AND date(f2.business_date)<=date(i.business_date)) WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND date(i.due_date)<=date('2026-10-30') ORDER BY i.event_key"}}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00') AND date(business_date)<=date('2026-10-23')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status<>'void'), totals AS (SELECT invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='payment' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS payments,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='credit' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS credits,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='hold' AND status='active' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) AS holds FROM active WHERE kind IN ('payment','credit','hold') GROUP BY invoice_id), amounts AS (SELECT i.event_key,MAX(0,MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE(a.payments,0)-COALESCE(a.credits,0))-COALESCE(a.holds,0)) * CASE WHEN date('2026-10-23')<=date(i.discount_until) THEN 10000-t.discount_bps ELSE 10000 END * f.fx_num AS numerator,10000*f.fx_den AS denominator FROM active i LEFT JOIN totals a ON a.invoice_id=i.event_key JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date=(SELECT MAX(t2.business_date) FROM active t2 WHERE t2.kind='terms' AND t2.terms_code=i.terms_code AND date(t2.business_date)<=date(i.business_date)) JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date=(SELECT MAX(f2.business_date) FROM active f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.currency=i.currency AND date(f2.business_date)<=date(i.business_date)) WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND date(i.due_date)<=date('2026-10-30')), rounded AS (SELECT event_key,CAST((2*numerator+denominator)/(2*denominator) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM amounts WHERE denominator>0) SELECT event_key,usd_cents,SUM(usd_cents) OVER () AS total_usd_cents FROM rounded WHERE usd_cents>=0 ORDER BY event_key"}}
